title: Sharp convergence rates for the vanishing discount problem with hyperbolic Aubry sets
summary: Let $H\in C^2(T^*M)$ be a Tonelli Hamiltonian on a closed connected manifold and let $u_λ$ solve \[ λu_λ+H(x,Du_λ)=c(H)\qquad\text{in }M. \] We study the convergence rate of $u_λ$ to the selected critical solution $u_0$. Assume that the lifted Aubry set is a finite union $\widetilde{A}=Γ_1\sqcup\cdots\sqcupΓ_N$, where each $Γ_i$ is either a hyperbolic equilibrium or a periodic orbit hyperbolic in the critical energy level. We prove \[ -Cλ\le u_λ-u_0\le Cλ|\logλ|. \] Let $μ_i$ be the projected Mather measure associated with $Γ_i$. If \[ \int_M u_0\,\mathrm dμ_i=0\qquad \text{for every }i, \]…
